candidate.educational_objective: Select footwear that supports safe ambulation and fall prevention.

options.A: Well-fitting footwear with a stable sole and tread or appropriate gripper socks.
options.B: Loose socks with a smooth sole.
options.C: Bare feet on a polished floor.

candidate.rationale: AHRQ fall-prevention guidance recommends safe footwear that fits well and has a stable shape and tread; gripper socks may be used when safe shoes cannot be worn.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Safe, well-fitting footwear with tread is a recognized fall-prevention measure.
candidate.source_document_title: The Falls Management Program—How to Reduce Falls
candidate.source_locator: Residents' living space and personal safety—footwear with tread, firm shape, low even heel; use gripper socks when needed
candidate.source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
candidate.stem: A hospitalized client will ambulate to the bathroom. Which footwear best supports fall prevention?
